nodes.title: Labelled diagrams are code-picked (C1 item 5): label-pick.js gives label@1 to a kit ABOUT a thing's parts (names the thing and >= 3 of its parts; a plant also needs stem and root), each label the kit's own word on a leader to its anchor; explainerFor tries it before the library and the key-terms board. The plant sketch is redrawn (soil, branching roots, curved stem, two leaves with midribs, a fruit on a stalk, a five-petal flower) and every anchor is on a drawn part: the old sketch pointed 'fruit' at a leaf. Recording docs/design/round7/studio/label-plant-*. Next: more sketches (circuit 9 kits, cell 3, atom 3).

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-board-label-diagrams: science lessons get real labelled diagrams (2026-11-04)

A lesson about the parts of a plant now shows a drawn plant with each part labelled in the kit's own words, on a line to the part. The old plant drawing labelled a leaf as the fruit; it is redrawn so every label points at what it names.
